item.title: Associate professor: 10/FICP-01 GREEK AND LATIN PHILOLOGY, EARLY CHRISTIAN LITERATURE, PAPYROLOGY (Univ. Catt. S.Cuore)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-02 16:00
Institution: Univ. Catt. S.Cuore, Milano
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/FICP-01 Filologia greca e latina, letteratura cristiana antica, papirologia

From a scientific perspective, the candidate will conduct research into ancient Christian literature in Greek and Latin, as well as its tradition in other ancient languages, using philological and literary-critical research methods, with a particular focus on the production and interpretation of the foundational texts of the Christian tradition.
